data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to select images and videos from the library or camera with crop and compression.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to pick multiple images and videos from the photo album, take photos or videos using the camera, crop and compress media, and save files to the device gallery on Android and iOS.
use_when: You need a WeChat-style multi-image and video picker for Android and iOS.
You want built-in image cropping and compression options during selection.
You need to save images or videos directly to the device album.
avoid_when: You require web support (since this plugin focuses on Android and iOS).
You want a pure Flutter UI widget without native platform view wrappers.
strengths: Supports multiple image and video selection with a WeChat-style UI.
Built-in support for image cropping, compression, and video duration limits.
Includes localization for multiple languages out of the box.
weaknesses: Platform support is limited to Android and iOS.
Compression and cropping options can sometimes have platform-specific behaviors or limitations.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding camera, microphone, and photo library permissions in iOS Info.plist and Android Manifest, plus configuring minSdkVersion 21 on Android.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official and widely-used plugin for picking images and videos across multiple platforms including web.
